definitions.gloss: flesh of fruit; fruit pulp; fruit meat
definitions.explanation: The soft, edible inner part of a fruit, excluding the skin, seeds, and core. Used in cooking, food descriptions, and product labels.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{果肉|かにく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
{果肉|かにく}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジャム→ジャム：01779_jamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made jam packed with fruit pulp.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{果肉|かにく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{飲|の}みごたえ→飲みごたえ：08085_nomigotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This juice has fruit pulp in it, so it's satisfying to drink.

notes:
Composed of {果|か} (fruit) + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (flesh, meat). A practical word commonly seen on food packaging, recipes, and product descriptions. Essential for understanding food labels in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果肉|かにく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — contains fruit pulp
- {果肉|かにく}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧ — full of fruit flesh
- {果肉|かにく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧ — the flesh is soft
- {果肉|かにく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ — thick-fleshed
- ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{果肉|かにく} — white flesh (e.g., of a pear)
